links.outcome: Missed red flag rate and diagnostic accuracy in adversarial simulated multi-turn encounters
links.effect: Trained agent improved diagnostic accuracy under adversarial conditions (88.0% vs. 81.0%) and reduced missed red flag rates by 31% relative to the base model.
links.quote: On held-out evaluations, the ResidencyRL agent improves diagnostic accuracy by 7.0% under adversarial conditions (88.0% vs. 81.0%) and reduces missed red flag rates by 31%, demonstrating rigorous mitigation of premature closure.

unlisted_practices: Reinforcement learning training of clinical agents in simulated multi-turn encounters with adversarial LLM patient simulators and safety-aligned reward

screen.reason: The paper presents and evaluates ResidencyRL, an RL-based agent training framework evaluated in simulated multi-turn clinical encounters and benchmarks; it evaluates model/training design rather than an organizational deployment practice or operational safeguard.
